notes.title: bug fix
notes.notes:
bug fix
A phenomenon in which voice volume could not be adjusted was discovered and corrected in Amiru's second sex scene.

We discovered and fixed an issue where the 2x speed button would display incorrectly when continuing right after finishing a game.


New feature
You will now see instructions on how to operate it during sex scenes.
This task only runs once.

notes.title: Game balance patch. Heart gauge acquisition amount has been increased.
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708767/028f3cc1a547b85d5a27144871ce23166720fad8.png


Heart gauge acquisition amount has been increased.
The time it takes to unlock the gallery has now been significantly reduced.

note
Enemy die values and your die values are random and not manipulated arbitrarily.
Even if you lose, you don't lose any points.

We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
